Body is split into two side-by-side flowchart panels of nearly equal size: LEFT panel = classic Transformer architecture diagram on a white card; RIGHT panel = the same architecture with colored Encoder/Decoder highlight regions and a green border. A large solid red right-pointing block arrow sits in the vertical gap between the panels at mid-height. A thin dark-red frame runs around the slide perimeter.

visual_elements.description: LEFT PANEL: classic Transformer architecture (Vaswani et al. style) on a white card with thin black border. Two vertical stacks connected by thin black lines with small arrowheads; curved elbow connectors run along both sides of each sublayer into its 'Add & Norm' box. ENCODER STACK (left column), bottom to top: plain-text label 'Inputs' -> pink box 'Input Embedding' -> small circle with plus sign (sum node) fed from the left by a small circle containing a black sine-wave icon labeled 'Positional Encoding' (two lines) -> orange box 'Multi-Head Attention' (two lines) -> yellow box 'Add & Norm' -> blue box 'Feed Forward' (two lines) -> yellow box 'Add & Norm'; repetition label 'Nx' sits to the LEFT of the stack at the Feed-Forward level. DECODER STACK (right column), bottom to top: plain-text label 'Outputs (shifted right)' (two lines) -> pink box 'Output Embedding' -> plus-sum circle fed from the right by a sine-wave circle labeled 'Positional Encoding' -> orange box 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' (three lines) -> yellow box 'Add & Norm' -> orange box 'Multi-Head Attention' (two lines; receives an elbow connector from the encoder stack's top 'Add & Norm') -> yellow box 'Add & Norm' -> blue box 'Feed Forward' -> yellow box 'Add & Norm' -> lavender box 'Linear' -> green box 'Softmax' -> plain-text label 'Output Probabilities' (two lines) at top; repetition label 'Nx' sits to the RIGHT of the stack at the Feed-Forward level. Box label texts appear 2x 'Feed Forward', 5x 'Add & Norm', 2x 'Multi-Head Attention', 1x 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' within this panel.
visual_elements.position: left half of slide, x ~8-43%, y ~18-97%

visual_elements.description: RIGHT PANEL: identical Transformer flowchart structure and identical verbatim box/label texts as the left panel, but color-coded: the whole panel is a white card with a ~2pt GREEN border; a peach rectangle behind the left (encoder) column is headed 'Encoder' in red bold italic at its top-left; a light-green rectangle behind the right (decoder) column is headed 'Decoder' in green bold italic at its top-right. Encoder-side boxes are slightly muted/tinted (grayish-blue 'Feed Forward', tan/orange 'Multi-Head Attention'); decoder-side boxes have a greenish tint (pale-green 'Feed Forward', pale yellow-green attention boxes); 'Add & Norm' pale yellow, embeddings pink, 'Linear' lavender, 'Softmax' green, same as left. Two small solid RED upward block arrows are added: one beside 'Inputs' at bottom-left of the encoder region, one beside 'Output Probabilities' at top of the decoder region. Same 'Nx', 'Positional Encoding', sine-wave circle icons, plus-sum circles and curved side connectors as the left panel.
